integrity: The gamma-function representation is obtained from the exact beta integral for the normalized cosine moment. Strict monotonicity follows independently from strict L^q-norm monotonicity for the nonconstant function |cos t|. The endpoint constants are derived from standard gamma-ratio and digamma expansions and were checked numerically only for consistency.
scientific_limitations: The result analyzes the Bohr-radius expression stated in the cited source and does not independently re-prove that source's separate global sharpness claim. Only first-order endpoint asymptotics are asserted. No convexity or complete-monotonicity property of the exponent dependence is claimed.
title: Logarithmic endpoint layer in the harmonic \(L^p\) Bohr-radius formula
